Many people have generously offered to help make whoaverse a better platform by offering to put their skills to use or money donations and I am very thankful for that.

While I can not accept any donations just yet, I have compiled a list of the things I could use some help with (off the top of my head) for anyone who would want to get involved and join whoaverse.

Developers with skills in C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, JavaScript and SQL databases

Whoaverse source code is available from GitHub along with instructions on how to setup your development environment. There you can also find the list of currently open issues that need working on.

Graphics designers with skills in vector illustrations and preferably CSS

Create CSS styles for default subs and graphical elements appropriate for each default sub.

Moderators for default subs

We need people to keep an eye on illegal and off-topic content being posted to default subs by helping to moderate these subs.

Legal advice, partner investor

Whoaverse needs to incorporate in a US-based LLC. I need a US-based partner to help register an LLC and secure whoaverse trademarks in exchange for ownership percentage in the newly built company.

The best way to get in touch with me is by sending an email to team@whoaverse.com and briefly describing yourself. Send a short biography and describe which area you want to help with.

How else can you help?

You can write a blog article reviewing whoaverse, following @whoaverse on twitter, telling your friends about whoaverse, but please, whatever you do, do not spam other sites with links to whoaverse.

I will keep updating this list, so please check back here every once in a while.

The best way to get mod access to default subverses is by getting in touch with me by email. Send a short bio and describe why you are the right person to moderate a certain sub and I will do what I can to assign the position to you. If you are a current moderator of a reddit sub and can prove it by sending me a pm from your mod account, that would be great. My reddit username is dt3ft.
I can offer moderation services, I have experience on Reddit with moderating moderately sized subs (up to ~50,000 users). Also just a warning, you've got a /v/Jailbait which may or may not be a joke.
